summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.69/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.69 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 11, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since July 17. AAA figures put the statewide average 32¢ lower than a week ago, 31¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.01 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Sheboygan ($3.40) and the highest in Mosinee ($4.00).
